nodes.title: Troubleshooting
widgets_values:
# Troubleshooting

**"Missing node types" when the workflow loads, or a node drawn in red** — a custom node pack is
not installed. This workflow needs Impact Pack, Impact Subpack and Inspyrenet Rembg; see the
Models & custom nodes note. Restart ComfyUI after installing, then reload the workflow.

**A combo box is red or empty** (checkpoint, LoRA, ControlNet, upscaler, hand or face detector)
— the model file is not where ComfyUI looks or is not named what the node asks for. Check it
against the table in that same note, `%20`s included, then press **R** to refresh node
definitions.

**The Pose skeleton node has no image** — the skeleton PNGs ship in the `skeletons/` folder
beside this workflow, and ComfyUI only lists images that have been uploaded to it. Click **choose
file to upload** on that node and pick one.

**Files land in `output/VenusUniversity/` with no folder, or the name has a stray slash** — an
outfit box is missing its `name:` prefix.

**Out of memory** — mute outfit boxes so fewer passes run, bypass the hi-res nodes (see the
Going faster note), or drop the base sampler’s resolution. Reload ComfyUI if it stays stuck.

**She has wolf ears and a tail** — `wolf_cut` does that. Add `animal_ears, wolf, tail` to the
Negative box.

**A sprite has a pale halo, or a piece of her is transparent** — that is the rembg threshold;
the expression-lane note explains which way to move it.

**The sprites look nothing like each other** — check the seed control is on `fixed`, and that
you did not edit the Appearance box between runs.

**Nothing queues** — at least one outfit box has to be unmuted, and the `Save: <emotion>` nodes
must not all be muted. ComfyUI only runs what a save node needs.

nodes.title: START HERE
widgets_values:
# START HERE

This workflow is based on the workflows used to generate character art for my game Venus University:
https://venus-dev.itch.io/venus-university

One run will get you, for each outfit you type in:

- **seven full body, transparent expression sprites**: neutral, happy, sad, angry, surprised, embarrassed, aroused,

and, if you switch group 6 on, **eight NSFW CG illustrations**.


## Checklist before you begin

1. **Models and custom nodes installed?** See the next note down. A red node or a red combo box
   means something is missing.
2. **Appearance prompt filled** — who she is: hair, eyes, body, makeup.
3. **Outfit 1–4** — one line each, in the form `name: tag, tag, tag`. Mute a box to skip it.
4. **Pose tags** + **Pose skeleton** — pick one of the ten poses, type its tags, upload its
   skeleton PNG. Both must be the same pose.
5. **Character seed** — Seed is fixed by default for character consistency. Set it to random for regenerations.
6. **Expression 1–7** — a line of face tags per emotion.
7. Press **Run** once.

The first run of a session has to load all the models so it may take a bit longer than later generations

## Output file location

```
ComfyUI/output/VenusUniversity/<outfit>/neutral.base_00001_.png
ComfyUI/output/VenusUniversity/<outfit>/neutral_00001_.png
ComfyUI/output/VenusUniversity/<outfit>/happy_00001_.png
ComfyUI/output/VenusUniversity/<outfit>/sad_00001_.png
ComfyUI/output/VenusUniversity/<outfit>/angry_00001_.png
ComfyUI/output/VenusUniversity/<outfit>/surprised_00001_.png
ComfyUI/output/VenusUniversity/<outfit>/embarrassed_00001_.png
ComfyUI/output/VenusUniversity/<outfit>/aroused_00001_.png
ComfyUI/output/VenusUniversity/cg/<position>_00001_.png
```

`<outfit>` is whatever you wrote in front of the colon in that outfit box.

## How the game keeps the same art
If you're using this workflow to create character images for a Venus University character, replace the following files:

```
<character>/expressions/<emotion>.png      the default wardrobe
<character>/expressions/neutral.base.png   its base frame
<character>/outfits/<set>/<emotion>.png    the pe, swim and nude sets
<character>/cg/<position>.png              the CGs
```

nodes.title: NSFW CG GEN INSTRUCTIONS
widgets_values:
# NSFW CG Generation

This part WON'T WORK until you do the following:

- **Unmute `Save CG`** by selecting it and press Ctrl+M.

Files will be output here:

```
output/VenusUniversity/cg/<position>_00001_.png
```

To switch the CGs off again, mute `Save CG`. Mute an individual position box to skip that one CG.

## Default tags

| box | tags |
| --- | --- |
| nude_foreplay | `nude, solo, nipples, pussy, on_back` |
| nude_foreplay_after | `nude, solo, nipples, pussy, on_back, after_sex` |
| sex | `nude, solo_focus, nipples, penis, pussy, on_back, vaginal` |
| sex_after | `nude, solo_focus, nipples, pussy, on_back, vaginal, after_sex, cum_on_body` |
| handjob | `nude, pov, handjob, penis` |
| handjob_after | `nude, pov, handjob, penis, after_sex, facial` |
| fellatio | `nude, pov, fellatio, penis` |
| fellatio_after | `nude, pov, handjob, after_fellatio, facial, cum_in_mouth, open_mouth, penis` |

## Differences from the game

The game autofills different expression for each position:

- her **aroused** tags for the four during positions: nude_foreplay, sex, handjob, fellatio
- her **happy** tags for the four `_after` ones
- for `fellatio` and `fellatio_after` it strips any mouth tag out of that line (clenched_teeth,
  frown, parted_lips, light_smile, smirk, grin, open_mouth) — her mouth is busy
- for the `_after` positions it also carries the aftermath tags out of the position and into the
  face pass (`after_sex`, `after_fellatio`, `facial`), plus `open_mouth` for `fellatio_after`

This workflow uses a single **CG expression** box covering all eight, holding her aroused line. To get the
game’s behaviour exactly, run the positions in two batches: the aroused line with the four
during positions unmuted, then the happy line (plus `after_sex, facial`, and `open_mouth` for
fellatio_after) with the four after ones.

nodes.title: About the Outfit boxes
widgets_values:
# Outfits

Four boxes, one outfit each, **one line per box**:

```
name: tag, tag, tag
```

The text before the colon will be the folder the oufit is saved to, keep it
short and safe for a filename (`everyday`, `pe`, `swim`, `nude`). If you don't have this, the images won't render

One press of Run renders **every box that is not muted**: base frame plus seven sprites each.
Select a box and press **Ctrl+M** to mute it and skip that outfit; Ctrl+M again brings it back.
Nothing else in the graph needs touching.

The game gives every girl three wardrobes, which is why three boxes are filled: her everyday
outfit, a PE kit, a swimsuit. Outfit 4 is empty and muted, free for anything — the game’s
fourth set is on the note below this one.

## Tips for tag writing

- **Colour and material on every garment.** `black_denim_miniskirt`, `white_faux_fur_jacket`,
  `pastel_yellow_two-piece_bikini`. 
- **Include skin exposure tags**: `cleavage`, `navel`, `thighs`, `bare_legs`,
  `bare_arms`, `bare_shoulders`, `clothing_cutout`.
- Please note that the negative includes holding to avoid props, remove if you want handbags or held items

## Example outfits

**April Valentine, everyday**

`everyday: pink_cropped_top, white_faux_fur_jacket, black_denim_miniskirt, black_lace_thighhighs,
pink_platform_heels, gold_chain_belt, cleavage, navel, thighs, bare_arms`

**Ana Fina, swimsuit**

`swim: pastel_yellow_two-piece_bikini, frilled_bikini_bottom, navel, bare_legs, bare_arms,
bare_shoulders, cleavage`

**Roxy Villeneuve, everyday**

`everyday: cropped black leather moto jacket, distressed red plaid bandeau, cleavage, navel,
ripped black denim micro shorts, silver chain belt, fishnet thighhighs, thighs,
black studded combat boots, black leather spiked choker`

## Swimsuits need four extra negatives

When the game renders a swimsuit it adds `pantyhose, thighhighs, pants, gloves` to the negative,
because those garments survive from whatever the model thinks a girl wears. There is one shared
Negative box here, so this workflow does not do it for you. If your swimsuit comes back in
tights, paste those four tags into the **Negative** box and render that outfit on its own.

nodes.title: About the Appearance box
widgets_values:
# Appearance

Appearance tags are how we keep character consistency. These are the things that should be the same in all images: hair, eyes, body, makeup. Comma-separate the tags in booru-style for Illustrious models.

Venus University uses these tag categories which are represented well in danbooru database for better consistency:

**Hair colour** — `{shade}_{colour}_hair`. Shade is optional, `light` or `dark`. Colour is one
of aqua, black, blonde, blue, brown, green, grey, orange, pink, purple, red, white.

**Eye colour** — `{shade}_{colour}_eyes`. Colour is one of aqua, black, blue, brown, green,
grey, orange, pink, purple, red, yellow.

**Hair length** — pick one: `very_short_hair`, `short_hair`, `medium_hair`, `long_hair`.

**Hair texture** — pick one: `straight_hair`, `wavy_hair`, `curly_hair`, `messy_hair`.

**Hair style** — one or more: bob_cut, hime_cut, pixie_cut, wolf_cut, inverted_bob,
high_ponytail, low_ponytail, side_ponytail, twintails, low_twintails, single_braid, twin_braids,
double_bun, single_hair_bun, one_side_up, two_side_up, drill_hair.

**Bangs** — one or more: blunt_bangs, swept_bangs, parted_bangs, crossed_bangs,
hair_between_eyes, hair_over_one_eye, sidelocks, long sidelocks.

**Head accessories** — any number, and colour or material them freely: hairband, headband,
hair_ribbon, hair_bow, hairclip, hair_flower, hair_ornament, glasses, earrings, ear_piercing.
So `gold_hoop_earrings`, `green_hair_ribbon`, `round_glasses`.

**Breasts** — `small_breasts` or `big_breasts` or nothing for medium breasts

**Skin** — at most one of `tan`, `dark-skinned_female`, `freckles`. No tag means fair skin.

**Makeup** — up to two of `eyeshadow`, `eyelashes`.

## Examples

**April Valentine**

`light_pink_hair, light_blue_eyes, long_hair, curly_hair, wolf_cut, parted_bangs, sidelocks,
gold_hoop_earrings, silver_hairclips, eyeshadow, eyelashes, big_breasts`

**Ana Fina**

`light_brown_hair, light_green_eyes, long_hair, curly_hair, double_bun, crossed_bangs,
round_glasses, green_hair_ribbon, eyelashes, small_breasts`

**Ginny Hadron**

`dark_brown_hair, dark_red_eyes, medium_hair, messy_hair, wolf_cut, hair_between_eyes,
sidelocks, silver_hairclip, eyelashes, small_breasts`

One catch worth knowing: `wolf_cut` sometimes grows her wolf ears and a tail to match. Ginny
above carries `animal_ears, wolf, tail` in her negative in the game for exactly that reason.
Add those three to the **Negative** box if you see them.

**Breasts** — `small_breasts` or `big_breasts` or nothing for medium breasts

**Skin** — at most one of `tan`, `dark-skinned_female`, `freckles`. No tag means fair skin.

**Makeup** — up to two of `eyeshadow`, `eyelashes`.

## Examples

**April Valentine**

`light_pink_hair, light_blue_eyes, long_hair, curly_hair, wolf_cut, parted_bangs, sidelocks,
gold_hoop_earrings, silver_hairclips, eyeshadow, eyelashes, big_breasts`

**Ana Fina**

`light_brown_hair, light_green_eyes, long_hair, curly_hair, double_bun, crossed_bangs,
round_glasses, green_hair_ribbon, eyelashes, small_breasts`

**Ginny Hadron**

`dark_brown_hair, dark_red_eyes, medium_hair, messy_hair, wolf_cut, hair_between_eyes,
sidelocks, silver_hairclip, eyelashes, small_breasts`

One catch worth knowing: `wolf_cut` sometimes grows her wolf ears and a tail to match. Ginny
above carries `animal_ears, wolf, tail` in her negative in the game for exactly that reason.
Add those three to the **Negative** box if you see them.

nodes.title: explanation
widgets_values:
# What this is doing over here

The four outfit boxes go into **Make List (Any)**, which collects whatever is connected to it
into a *list* and quietly drops anything muted. ComfyUI runs a node once per element when one of
its inputs is a list, so from here on the whole graph is list-shaped: three unmuted boxes means
three prompts, three base frames, three of every sprite, three save files. Mute a box and that
element is gone; unmute Outfit 4 and a fourth appears. Nothing else has to change.

Appearance, the pose, the seed, the models are reused by every element.

## The prompt

Each box holds `name: tags`. **Outfit name** pulls out what is before the colon and **Outfit
tags** everything after it, both once per element.

The concat chain then builds the positive prompt in the same order the game does:

```
sprite preamble  +  appearance  +  outfit tags  +  pose tags        = base positive
base positive    +  one emotion’s tags                             = that sprite’s positive
```

The name also becomes the save path: `VenusUniversity/` + name + `/` + the expression. Since the
name is list-shaped too, sprite number 2 is saved under outfit number 2’s folder.

nodes.title: explanation
widgets_values:
# The base frame pass

The trick is we generate a single base pose image and do FaceDetailer passes on it for expressions for consistency and time:

1. **Base positive** = sprite preamble + appearance + that outfit’s tags + pose tags. The
   Negative box is shared by every sampling and detailing stage in the workflow.
2. **Pose control** applies the openpose skeleton at strength 1 over the first half of the
   sampling (0 → 0.5): the pose is fixed early, the details are free later.
3. **Base sampler** — 832×1216, 16 steps, cfg 4, dpmpp_2m_sde / sgm_uniform.
4. **Hi-res pass** — Real-ESRGAN ×4, scaled back down ×0.35 (so ×1.4 overall), re-encoded and
   resampled for 12 steps at denoise 0.3. 
5. **Hand detailer** — the hand YOLO finds hands and re-renders each one at 512 with a wide
   crop (×6) at denoise 0.3.
6. The frame is saved as `<outfit>/neutral.base`, an opaque, white background, no expression base, and
   handed to **Background cut (rembg)**, which works out which pixels are background.

nodes.title: Going faster
widgets_values:
# Going faster
I don't recommend sacrificing quality for speed, but you can do the following to shorten generation time:
- **Skip the hi-res pass.** Select `Upscale ×4`, `Scale back down ×0.35`, `Encode for refine`
  and `Hi-res refine`, and press **Ctrl+B** to bypass them. The base frame then comes straight
  off the first sampler: roughly half the time, slightly softer lines.
- **Skip the hand detailer** the same way, if the hands are fine or you are only testing faces.
- **Mute outfits you do not need** (Ctrl+M on the box). Each one is a whole base pass plus seven
  face passes.
- **Mute expressions you don't need**: Ctrl+M the `Save: <emotion>` node and that expression won't generate

nodes.title: explanation
widgets_values:
# What this part is doing (Expression gen)

Each lane runs facedetailer on the base image for the outfit:

1. **Face prompt** = the base positive plus that emotion’s tags.
2. **Pose control** at strength 1 across the whole sampling (0 → 1), so the repainted head stays
   where the body put it.
3. **Face pass** — the face segmenter finds her face and only that region is re-rendered, at
   512, 12 steps, denoise 0.5. 
4. **Keep mask** = the background cut from rembg **plus** the face region shrunk by 10 px, so a
   repainted face is never clipped. Inverted and joined as alpha, that gives an RGBA sprite with
   a transparent background.
5. Saved as `<outfit>/<emotion>`.

nodes.title: Models & custom nodes
widgets_values:
# Models & custom nodes

**ComfyUI 0.34 or newer** is recommended.

## Custom node packs

Install all three (ComfyUI Manager, or clone into `ComfyUI/custom_nodes`) and restart ComfyUI:

- **Impact Pack** — https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Pack
  (for FaceDetailer and MakeList)
- **Impact Subpack** — https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack
  (Ultralytics detectors)
- **Inspyrenet Rembg** — https://github.com/john-mnz/ComfyUI-Inspyrenet-Rembg


## Model files


**Checkpoint — Nova Anime XL, version `IL v19.0`**

- https://civitai.com/models/376130/nova-anime-xl
- downloads as `NovaAnimeILV190.safetensors`, rename to `novaAnimeXL_ilV190.safetensors` or manually select the model 
- goes in `models/checkpoints`

**Style LoRA — USNR STYLE, version `USNR_STYLE_ILL_V1.0`**

- https://civitai.com/models/176554/usnr-style
- rename to `usnrStyle.safetensors` or manually select the model 
- goes in `models/loras`

**ControlNet — Illustrious-XL ControlNet Openpose**

- https://civitai.com/models/1359846/illustrious-xl-controlnet-openpose
- rename to `illustriousOpenpose.safetensors` or manually select the model 
- goes in `models/controlnet`

**Upscaler — Real-ESRGAN anime 6B**

- https://github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN/releases/tag/v0.2.2.4
- the file is `RealESRGAN_x4plus_anime_6B.pth`, keep the name
- goes in `models/upscale_models`

**Hand detector — hand_yolov9c.pt**

- https://huggingface.co/Bingsu/adetailer
- the file is `hand_yolov9c.pt`, keep the name
- goes in `models/ultralytics/bbox`

**Face segmenter — Anzhc Face seg 640 v2 y8n**

- https://huggingface.co/Anzhc/Anzhcs_YOLOs
- the file is `Anzhc Face seg 640 v2 y8n.pt`, rename to
  `Anzhc%20Face%20seg%20640%20v2%20y8n.pt`or manually select the model. That wacky name is what's used in my game and I'm too lazy to change right now
- goes in `models/ultralytics/segm`

# Character seed

Character seed is fixed for all generations to keep appearance consistency. Change the seed from fixed to random for regenerations, otherwise you'll get the exact same image out.

# Pose

IMPORTANT: Match the **Pose tags** box with the **Pose skeleton** image. We use ControlNet to avoid weird camera angles and for character consistency across outfits.

**choose file to upload** button on the Pose skeleton node, then copy that row’s tags into the
Pose tags box.

nodes.title: About the Expression boxes
widgets_values:
# Expressions

Venus University supports these expressions: **neutral, happy, sad, angry,
surprised, embarrassed, aroused**, though you can technically use whatever expression tags you want.

The game builds from these groups:

- **General** (0–1): expressionless, happy, `(smug:0.5)`, `(angry:0.5)`, `(sad:0.7)`,
  `(embarrassed:0.5)`, `(surprised:0.7)`, naughty_face
- **Eyebrows** (0–1): raised_eyebrow, raised_eyebrows, furrowed_brow
- **Mouth** (0–1): clenched_teeth, `(frown:0.5)`, parted_lips, light_smile, smirk, grin,
  open_mouth
- **Eyes** (0–1): `(half-closed_eyes:0.7)`, `(wide-eyed:0.6)`, one_eye_closed,
  looking_at_viewer, sideways_glance
- **Other** (0–2): tears, blush

The weights listed are the minimum value I recommend. I don't recommend going past 0.9 otherwise the faces can get a little exaggerated and un-pretty

I also recommend using looking_at_viewer for the neutral/happy expression or whatever will be the character's default
